claim: The proposal's addendum ("Migration is a constraint on landing order, not a feature") and drift-spexmachina-uiei.4.json's proposed_fix both say this repository's own state files — spec/.snapshot.json, spec/.history.jsonl, and root absorb.json — must move into .spex/ "in the same PR" that lands the real ProjectResolver (this bead) and DiffCommand/MapCommand/PlanCommand's switch to calling it, or main is self-broken (spex diff/map/plan/register would refuse this very repository as uninitialised). But CLAUDE.md's Spec Change Doctrine says "The baseline (spec/.snapshot.json) moves only deliberately — a mint when work is born, a refresh when a correction owes none — always in the authoring loop, never automated, never in a box," and implementer boxes "never write spec/ — the portitor gate denies it structurally." This bead runs as an implementer box.
authoritative_source: CLAUDE.md's Spec Change Doctrine, which is this repository's own operating contract for implementer boxes and takes precedence over a proposal's landing-order note: the baseline (and, by the same reasoning, the journal it is paired with — the one artifact in the system that cannot be reconstructed from anything else) is moved only in the authoring loop, on a deliberate mint-or-refresh decision, never by a box.
evidence: This PR builds the real lifecycle.Resolve and switches DiffCommand, MapCommand's three children, PlanCommand and RegisterCommand to call it for their default snapshot/journal locations, exactly as their own already-merged arch leaves (arch_diff_command.md, arch_map_command.md via test_map_command.md, arch_plan_command.md, test_proposal_commands.md) require. It does not move spec/.snapshot.json, spec/.history.jsonl or absorb.json, and does not create .spex/ in this repository, because doing so is either a baseline move (the snapshot) or sits beside one (the journal), and CLAUDE.md reserves both for the authoring loop. The consequence, until that authoring-loop step runs: spex diff/map/plan/register invoked against this repository's own spec/ (--spec-dir defaulting to spec/) refuse with the not-a-spex-project exit code, since .spex/ does not exist yet at the project root — the self-broken-main state the proposal's addendum warns about, presently unavoidable without an authoring-loop action this bead is not permitted to take. The .gitignore fix the proposal also calls for (".spex/ must be checked so it is committed") is not spec and not the baseline, so this PR does make that change (the stale `.spex/` entry, a leftover from a pre-lifecycle /converge pipeline concept, is removed from .gitignore) — it is only the file relocation itself that is withheld.
proposed_fix: In the authoring loop (a /propose or /drift-fix session, or an equivalent deliberate step outside a box), move spec/.snapshot.json to .spex/snapshot.json, spec/.history.jsonl to .spex/history.jsonl, and absorb.json to .spex/runs/absorb.json, byte-for-byte (no mint, no refresh — the baseline's content and meaning do not change, only its location), then verify spex diff/map/plan/register succeed against this repository afterward. This is naturally paired with landing InitCommand (spexmachina-uiei.10), whose own arch leaf documents the two files it seeds — the migration is that same seed, applied once by hand to this repository's pre-existing state rather than freshly by spex init.
